At the same time, OFDMA divides each wireless channel into smaller sub-channels for greater reach and efficiency. ASUS AiMesh support allows you to create a mesh network by adding compatible routers to your network as satellites to expand coverage. A mesh network operates using a single network ID (SSID) and automatically hands your device's connection to the satellite with the strongest signal to ensure uninterrupted connections as you stream 4K videos and play online games while moving from room to room. Triple-Level Game Acceleration

Using the OpenNAT feature allows you to join your clan by configuring port forwarding in three easy steps instead of dealing with complicated procedures.

Complete Security

By creating a secure tunnel to your ROG GT-AX11000 Pro at home, you can enjoy secure connections from almost anywhere in the world. The hAP-Lite includes a RouterOS L4 license, which enables access to advanced features and capabilities. Additionally, it comes with a USB power supply, offering flexibility in powering the device.
